answer: Admission auctions stop fake identities. 100 slots open; applicants bid a deposit, top bids enter, and winners must pass work checks or forfeit it. The deposit anchors an identity to one slot, so fakes cannot wander from slot to slot collecting rewards. A bridge to work is required: no completed work, no payout. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 20 = 2,000 tokens locked, plus forfeiture. One honest agent pays 20 once and earns undiluted rewards.
